headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,183 INTO HOLIDAY WEEKEND — SILVER ABOVE $61, COPPER $6.17/LB AS PAYROLLS RALLY EXTENDS ON THIN PRE-JULY 4 TRADE
snippet: Gold extended its payrolls-driven recovery to $4,183.45/oz (up 1.47%) on July 3, 2026, with silver holding above $61 and copper climbing to $6.17/lb as markets consolidate heading into the US Independence Day holiday weekend with Federal Reserve September rate-hike probability below 50%. Thin pre-holiday liquidity is keeping position-taking measured; the next material catalyst is the Fed Chair's policy signal expected within four weeks, with UBS maintaining a $6,300/oz year-end target amid continued central bank accumulation.

headline: 1.50m @ 8.33% CU, 11.30 g/t AU, 971 g/t AG — BRIXTON METALS DRILLS BONANZA FEEDER ZONE AT THORN PROJECT IN NW BRITISH COLUMBIA (TSXV:BBB)
source_name: North of 60 Mining News / Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV:BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV:BBB) reported that hole THN26-372 at the Glenfiddich Zone on the Thorn Project in northwest British Columbia intercepted 14.75 metres of 1.25% copper, 1.71 g/t gold, and 149 g/t silver from 84.25 metres depth — including a 1.50-metre core of 8.33% copper, 11.30 g/t gold, and 971 g/t silver, among the highest near-surface multi-metal grades reported in BC this drilling season. The Glenfiddich Zone is interpreted as a feeder structure to the large Camp Creek copper-gold porphyry system at depth, and current drilling is designed to extend the zone to support an updated NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate.

headline: C$2.2M DISTRICT PUSH IN TOODOGGONE — TDG GOLD MOBILIZES 55km IP SURVEY AND 2,000 SOIL SAMPLES NORTHWEST OF AURORA COMPLEX (TSXV:TDGC)
snippet: TDG Gold Corp. (TSXV:TDGC) mobilized June 30, 2026 for a C$2.2 million district-scale copper-gold exploration program targeting systems northwest of the recently discovered Aurora Complex in the Toodoggone District of northern British Columbia — deploying 55 line-kilometres of direct-current induced polarization geophysics and a 2,000-sample systematic soil survey. The program is designed to identify new drill targets for the 2027 season within a metallogenic corridor that neighbours the historical Kemess mine and sits adjacent to multiple porphyry copper-gold deposits.

headline: MINNESOTA DNR CLEARS DRILLING AT DULUTH COMPLEX CU-NI-PGE DEPOSIT — GREEN BRIDGE METALS SELECTS FORACO FOR PHASE 1, STARTS AUGUST (CSE:GRBM)
snippet: Green Bridge Metals Corporation (CSE:GRBM) announced July 2, 2026 that the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources has approved its exploration drilling plan for the Serpentine Copper-Nickel Project in St. Louis County, Minnesota — a bulk-tonnage copper-nickel-PGE deposit within the Duluth Complex, North America's premier polymetallic critical minerals district — and that Foraco International has been selected to drill a minimum 1,640-metre Phase 1 diamond core program commencing August 2026. The approval advances a strategically important US domestic critical minerals project containing copper, nickel, cobalt, and platinum-group metals aligned with the Trump administration's critical minerals supply-chain priorities.

headline: MYRIAD URANIUM SPUDS PHASE II AT COPPER MOUNTAIN WYOMING — 4,500m PROGRAM TARGETS LUCKY CLIFF DEPOSIT UNTOUCHED SINCE 1970s (CSE:M)
snippet: Myriad Uranium Corp. (CSE:M) announced July 2, 2026 that Phase II drilling has commenced at the Copper Mountain Uranium Project in Wyoming, with the first four holes targeting the Lucky Cliff area — drilled by Union Pacific in the late 1970s and never followed up with modern methods — as part of a 4,500-metre two-stage program that may expand to 7,000–10,000 metres. Copper Mountain hosts multiple historical uranium deposits and the past-producing Arrowhead Mine (~500,000 lbs U₃O₈), with Myriad holding a 75% interest and a definitive agreement to acquire the remaining 25%.

headline: GENERATION URANIUM LAUNCHES SUMMER PROGRAM AT YATH — MMT AIRBORNE SURVEY FLIES KIVALLIQ'S ANGILAK DISTRICT WITH SURFACE SAMPLES TO 9.8% U3O8 (TSXV:GEN)
source_name: Investing News Network / Generation Uranium Inc. (TSXV:GEN)
snippet: Generation Uranium Inc. (TSXV:GEN) announced July 2, 2026 the start of its inaugural summer field program on the Yath Project in Nunavut's Kivalliq Region, commissioning Expert Geophysics to fly an MMT airborne geophysical survey over the central and western portions of the property while ground teams undertake prospecting and structural mapping to define drill targets at multiple historic uranium showings. Historic surface samples at Yath have returned values up to 9.8% U₃O₈; the 2026 program is designed to deliver a ranked drill target list for a drilling permit application in the Angilak district, one of Canada's most active emerging uranium camps.

headline: GERMANIUM MINING COMPLETES TDEM SURVEY AT QUEBEC PROPERTY — CHINA EXPORT CONTROLS MAKE EVERY WESTERN GERMANIUM DEPOSIT STRATEGICALLY CRITICAL (CSE:GMC)
snippet: Germanium Mining Corp. (CSE:GMC) announced July 3, 2026 that Time Domain Electromagnetic geophysical work is complete over a 1,400m × 1,400m area at its Lac du Km 35 Germanium Project in Quebec's Chibougamau Region, with a final anomaly report expected within days identifying conductors associated with germanium-silver-zinc mineralisation. Germanium has become one of the most geopolitically sensitive technology metals of 2026 after China's export controls severely restricted supply of the critical semiconductor, solar, and fibre-optics material, making Quebec primary germanium exploration among the most strategically compelling small-cap mineral plays in North America.

headline: CHINA IMPORTED 790+ TONNES OF SILVER IN EARLY 2026 — GOLD SWOT SAYS SOLAR DEMAND IS FLOOR-BUILDING, NOT A CEILING
snippet: VanEck's weekly Gold SWOT analysis on GoldSeek flags that China imported over 790 tonnes of silver in the first half of 2026 — predominantly for solar panel production — even as Western retail investors reduced exposure during the $55–60 correction, creating a structural demand floor that overrides short-term price weakness. The analysis frames tightening inventories and a projected 46+ million-ounce structural deficit as durable upside catalysts for silver heading into H2 2026, noting that China's continued accumulation at lower prices mirrors the central bank gold buying pattern that preceded gold's $5,589 peak in January.

headline: KITCO: GOLD AND SILVER IN 'RESET TO SETUP' MODE — Q3 2026 ENTRY WINDOW OPENS AS FED PIVOT RISK REPLACES RATE-HIKE RISK
snippet: Kitco News published July 1, 2026 a pre-holiday market analysis arguing that gold and silver are in a classic bull-market 'reset-to-setup' pattern following the January-to-June correction from $5,589 to below $4,000, with both metals now sitting on key long-term support and the payrolls miss validating a macro shift from 'rate hike risk' to 'rate cut opportunity.' The piece identifies the Fed Chair's expected mid-July policy signal as the decisive Q3 catalyst, and argues that central bank gold accumulation, structural silver deficits, and deeply discounted junior miners create a compounding entry window for informed retail investors before institutional money rotates back in.

headline: KAPPES CASSIDAY ENGAGED AT TOMBSTONE — AZTEC DRILLS 47 HOLES IN 2026 AND MOVES TO METALLURGICAL DE-RISKING OF ARIZONA BROWNFIELD RESTART (CVE:AZT)
snippet: Aztec Minerals Corp. (CVE:AZT) announced July 2, 2026 that it has engaged Kappes, Cassiday & Associates — the leading heap-leach metallurgical consultancy — to conduct initial bottle-roll NaCN leach testing on oxide gold-silver samples from 47 RC and core holes drilled at the historic Tombstone Project in Arizona since January 1, 2026, advancing metallurgical de-risking ahead of a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate. Drill intercepts to date include zones grading over 1.05 g/t gold and 23.21 g/t silver across 66.9 metres, and the metallurgical program will establish heap-leach processing parameters for a potential brownfield restart at one of Arizona's most storied precious metals districts.
